description: Reads the network configuration of ONE device, per network interface: `item` (the interface item name, the `interface` value the network write tools take), operatingMode, subnet, node {name, address, subnetMask}, pn {deviceName, autoGeneration, setDirectly, convertedName} (null when the PROFINET attributes are not readable, as on an interface that is not PROFINET), ioController {ioSystem} and ioConnector {ioSystem}. Read it before tia_pn_name_set, tia_io_system_connect or tia_io_system_disconnect. An unknown device is 404 not_found. `inventoryGaps` [{kind, subject, reason}] lists every read that failed while scanning (empty when all succeeded); a gap of kind `io_system_subnet` also carries `ioSystem` {number, controller}, the identity the serve decides on (`subject` is only the name). Requires a connected project. Maps to GET /devices/{device}/network. Read-only (class R).

device.description: device name, as listed by tia_devices
